title: Conversation tab labels stay on one line in a narrow chat column
steps: S1: Run the conversation-tabs-narrow e2e of tracy-chat-input: dsh's header and tabs from ConversationRoot.module.css with the plugin's real stylesheet, at 340/300/250/240/220px columns in light and dark.
expect: S1: every label renders on one line at every width; the gap is 20px at 340/300, 12px at 250/240, 8px with 12px labels at 220; the strip scrolls sideways rather than wrapping and does not clip the selection bar.
evidence: 21/10/2026 local cluster: below a ~290px column the tabs wrapped to 'Ch/at', 'Comm/ents', 'Traject/ory'
fence: The tab strip CSS of tracy-chat-input measured in Chromium against dsh's own header CSS
